---
title: "Data Science Certification Committee (DSCC)"
---

The DSCC oversees the entire certification process, makes all decisions about certification, and provides constructive feedback to applicants who are not approved.

## Composition

The DSCC consists of distinguished certified (or formerly certified, now retired) members of the ASA who are broadly representative of the membership. Members serve staggered three-year terms. DSCC members are appointed by the president-elect or the executive director according to the usual committee appointment practices of the ASA. The chair of the committee is also appointed by the appropriate president-elect or executive director to serve a three-year term, again in accordance with the ASA's usual processes.

## Responsibilities

The DSCC:

- Makes recommendations to the Board of Directors regarding changes to the certification process
- Assists in the planning and provision of services to certified members
